pages.text: As OpenEngineering is a continuation of IE, we feel some improvements should be made to IE where it makes sense

pages.title: Chutes
pages.text: There have been some improvements to Chutes. There are now a chute for each sheetmetal type, and one for treated wood. Under the hood Chutes have been completely separated from Conveyor's

pages.title: Ladder Chutes
pages.text: Ladder Chutes is OpenEngineering's replacement to Covered Ladder's. They work the same way, but again have more types

pages.title: Concrete Layer
pages.text: OpenEngineering has replaced IE's concrete sheet, panel, and chunk with one block that behaves like snow
